summary.zh:
翠脉，取"翠"之玉色温润与"脉"之气血运行，以压电陶瓷振动模拟中医的推按手法，作用于头部经络淤堵之处——"翠"暗示触肤生凉、安神不躁的材质体验，"脉"直指疏通气血、缓解偏头痛的功能本质，二字合一，将科技振动转化为如古人以玉枕"玉气润经脉"的中式养生叙事。

头部不适与压力相关的困扰在当下其实非常普遍。翠脉是一款采用压电陶瓷脉冲振动技术的可穿戴头部舒缓仪器，能精准缓解因伏案办公、专注学习等场景引发的头部胀痛、偏头痛与肌肉紧张。它以轻量化贴耳式设计，采用传统棉麻编织与镍钛记忆合金为主的材料，适配多元生活场景，不干扰工作与娱乐。控制操作极简直观、材质亲肤透气，无论上班族的疲劳时刻，还是长辈的日常舒缓需求都能满足，是全家共享、随时随地为头部减压的随身健康好物。
summary.en:
EmeVibe combines the warm and smooth jade color of "翠 (Cui)" with the circulation of "脉 (Mai)" of blood and qi. It uses piezoelectric ceramic vibration to simulate the pushing and pressing techniques in traditional Chinese medicine, acting on the blocked meridians in the head - "Cui" implies the material experience of skin contact generating coolness and calming the mind without agitation, while "Mai" directly points to the function of promoting blood circulation and relieving tension headaches. The combination of these two words transforms the technological vibration into a Chinese-style health narrative similar to the ancient practice of using a jade pillow to "moisten the meridians with jade qi".

Head discomfort and stress-related problems are actually very common nowadays. EmeVibe is a wearable head relaxation device that uses piezoelectric ceramic pulse vibration technology. It can precisely relieve head pain, tension headaches, and muscle tension caused by scenarios such as desk work and concentrated study. It features a lightweight ear-attached design, using traditional cotton and linen weaving and nickel-titanium memory alloy as the main materials, suitable for various life scenarios, without interfering with work and entertainment. The control operation is extremely intuitive and visually pleasing, with a skin-friendly and breathable material. Whether it's the fatigue moments of office workers or the daily relaxation needs of elders, it can meet all requirements. It is a portable health good that can be shared by the whole family and relieve stress for the head anytime and anywhere.

summary.zh:
“灵枢”一词出自《黄帝内经》：“经络腧穴”“脏腑气血输布之枢纽”，原意为针灸、经络学中的“灵巧之枢纽”，强调通过关键节点的调控，激活人体自组织能力，今则引申为事物的核心机制或关键环节。

在环境污染仍无法根治的今天，我们分别从农业、科技、生物等多个领域和角度出发，探寻未来生态、未来生存的新关键和新形式。在对未来世界的想象中想象发展的关键节点，基于一定的理论探索建立可持续的生态调节、发展机制，为未来设计。

在视觉的表达上，我们希望通过对资源、气候、社会、生物等几个角度所抛出来的问题来表现我们这次设计的主题。并针对这次的世界观提取了主要元素来完成相关设计和主配色的选取。

色彩不仅还原了生态危机世界观下的视觉真实，更表达了我们所思考的一种深刻的价值立场。它回应土地的荒芜、资源的消耗与文明的沉降；也投射出在困局之中，人类仍有转向之可能。黄色象征复苏，锈红如警钟长鸣，而灰蓝天幕则像是遥远却仍在的希望；标志如同星体运行的轨道，既象征生态系统的物质、能量的往复流转，也寓意在生态危机的“临界点”，人类与自然能够实现关键转向；内层小圆形态取自瞳孔，承接形态的设计逻辑：既代表“感知 — 反思 — 行动”的链条，呼应“观察环境、理解危机、寻找转向”的价值，也隐喻人类在“废墟与希望交织的未来”中，对生态和命运的凝视与抉择。
summary.en:
A visual identity project for Miraculous Pivot. The term "Miraculous Pivot (Lingshu)" comes from Yellow Emperor’s Inner Canon (Huangdi Neijing), referring to "the pivotal point of meridians, acupoints, zang-fu organs and the distribution of qi and blood". Originally it means the "smart hub" in acupuncture and meridian studies, emphasizing that we can activate the body's self-organizing ability by regulating those key nodes. Now it's extended to mean the core mechanism or critical link of things.

In terms of visual expression, we aim to convey the theme of our design by addressing issues from several angles such as resources, climate, society, and biology. We have extracted the main elements from this worldview to complete the related design and select the main color scheme.

The color not only restores the visual reality under the worldview of ecological crisis but also expresses a profound value stance that we have contemplated. It responds to the desolation of the land, the consumption of resources, and the decline of civilization; it also projects that in the predicament, humans still have the possibility of turning. Yellow symbolizes recovery, rust red like a long alarm bell, and the gray-blue sky backdrop is like a distant yet still existing hope; the logo is like the orbit of celestial bodies, symbolizing the reciprocal circulation of matter and energy in the ecosystem, and also implying that at the "critical point" of ecological crisis, humans and nature can achieve a key turning point; the inner small circular shape is derived from the pupil, following the design logic: it represents the chain of "perception - reflection - action", echoes the value of "observing the environment, understanding the crisis, and seeking a turning point", and also metaphorically represents that in the "future intertwined with ruins and hope", humans gaze at and make choices about ecology and destiny.

summary.zh: 艺术与科技专业，信息与空间研究中心展厅的展陈与视觉导引设计。展厅主题围绕海上丝绸之路的古今演变展开，物料制作在此主题的基础上贴合此次专业“深蓝创想”毕业设计主题进一步衍生，设计制作了包括“海丝游径”导览册、广州古地图展厅地贴、一套共12种样式的古建介绍小卡等展厅物料，同时利用微信小程序AR技术展现相关文化遗产介绍视频和图标，在观众观看作品、了解海丝文化的同时增添新奇感和记忆点。
summary.en: Art and Science Major, Exhibition and Visual Guidance Design of the Information and Space Research Center. The exhibition theme revolves around the evolution of the Maritime Silk Road throughout history. The material production is further developed based on this theme and in line with the current professional "Deep Blue Imagination" graduation design theme. Exhibition materials such as the "Maritime Silk Road Tour Guide Book", floor stickers for the Guangzhou Ancient Map, and a set of 12 different styles of ancient architecture introduction cards were designed and produced. At the same time, the AR technology of the WeChat mini-program was utilized to present introduction videos and icons of related cultural heritage, adding novelty and memory points for the audience while they view the works and learn about the Maritime Silk Road culture.
